title.rendered: Student and Family Access and Engagement

excerpt.rendered:
Sherwood School District is dedicated to supporting and uplifting every student as they work to reach their academic and post secondary goals. In order to succeed in supporting all students, the district aspires to create welcoming and accessible learning and working environments for all students, families, and staff.

The department of Student & Family Access and Engagement’s goal is to cultivate connection, relationships resulting in a strong district community.

Through our connections and relationships we are able to collaborate with district students, staff, and families to honor, celebrate, and affirm the identities, perspectives and histories of Sherwood School District community members.
